Oh, I think there might be a misunderstanding. I'm not trying to set up an account right now. I’m actually really worried—my new Power Widget Pro started getting extremely hot while I was using it, and I smelled something burning, so I panicked and unplugged it. 

Is my house going to be okay? It's currently sitting unplugged on my desk, but I'm honestly scared to touch it. What should I do?

If I get a replacement, how can I be sure the new one won’t do the same thing? I really need to know that it's safe to use in my home. Also, what should I do with the one that overheated? I’m worried about just throwing it in the trash if it’s damaged like that.
